## About
The Walrus sits on East Main Street in Downtown Columbus. It's a long, skinny space with a brick wall that bears our name, lots of tall tables, a pool table in the back and big round booths that are worth fighting for.
We serve comfort food for lunch, dinner and late night, with full service dining and carryout. There are vegetarian and vegan options, a full bar and wine list, and lots of craft brews on tap. Bring friends, family or the folks from work.
Our main goal is to bring a little music to downtown. Guests have given us a 4.4 rating from 2968 Google reviews, and we'd love to see you on the patio.

## Services
- Weekend brunch: Served Saturday and Sunday. Try the chicken and waffles, the el morsa with Ohio chorizo gravy, or fried French toast with Ohio made maple syrup.
- Live music on Saturdays: Live music every Saturday, with no cover.
- Trivia every Tuesday: Bring a team and test what you know.
- Karaoke every Wednesday: Grab the mic and sing one for the room.
- Online ordering for pickup or delivery: Order online and pick it up, or have it delivered.
- Office happy hours and birthday bashes: Planning an office happy hour or your birthday bash? Fill out our contact form and choose event planning.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need a reservation?
A: We suggest one. You can reserve online for groups of up to 15 people.

Q: Can I get food late at night?
A: Yes. The full menu is available late night on Fridays and Saturdays.

Q: How do I book my band to play The Walrus?
A: Fill out the contact form, select band booking, and include your requested date and links to your music or band page. We'll get back to you.
